exports.resolveFlacTimePolicy: (policy: Readonly<FlacTimePolicy>, sampleRate: number, totalSamples: bigint | null) => Readonly<ResolvedFlacTimePolicy>

policy.output: same; last occurrence per key, -t wins over -to regardless of ordering in each independent scope

result.startSample: bigint absolute source sample index, inclusive
result.endSampleExclusive: bigint exclusive source sample index, or null for unknown EOF
result.outputPtsSamples: bigint first output PTS in 1/sampleRate time base; currently zero

inputs: Exactly one input/output. Unchanged-rate decoded FLAC PCM only. Pass null for unknown STREAMINFO count (including STREAMINFO zero); explicit 0n means proven empty input. Sample rate integer 1..655350.
rounding: Parse to integer microseconds with existing FFmpeg duration parser (fractional truncation), then nearest sample with half ties away from zero. Output -t 0 is empty; input zero/rounded-zero -t is unlimited. EOF clips interval.
unsupported: Nonzero input -ss: Native FLAC demux seeking is not equivalent to sample trimming, including tiny positive seeks observed to yield EOF
Negative output -ss: Native shifts PTS and recording-time semantics
Positive output duration rounded to zero samples: Native emits one surviving decoder frame; cannot resolve boundary from these inputs
Time sentinels and overflowed derived duration
Stream copy, resampling, user filters and additional timestamp modes must be validated by integration owner
errors: ExecutionError invalid-time for syntax/negative duration/active -to <= -ss; unsupported-command for explicit gaps; invalid-arguments for invalid sample rate/count
lifetime: Synchronous immutable scalar snapshots, safe across awaits and command mutation. No borrowed option arrays. No I/O or promises.
memory: Fixed scalar state only, no media allocation, Core reservations or handles. Decoder/integration owns all Core memory reservations, cancellation, frame release, bounded slicing and atomic output group publication.
integration: Import directly from ./flac-wave-time.js. Compile before any await. Resolve after sample rate known; unknown EOF may require bounded decoder prepass for header counts. Intersect decoded frames with interval; preserve decoder frame boundaries; PTS = outputPtsSamples + emitted samples. Validate/reject copy, resampling, filters and other unsupported command options separately. Do not wire by modifying shared files in this wave.
